en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3294 - And it was narrated from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), from his father Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), from his forefathers, from Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), who said:
"The testimony of children is valid among them as long as they have not dispersed or returned to their families."
